description: POST /messages answers 201 for a new send and 200 for a replay of an Idempotency-Key, with the same SendResult body, so the status is the only way to tell them apart. This gives the operation its own response shape: SendResult plus `httpStatus`, bound to the response status code.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The thread the message landed in, which a concurrent send may have created. Adopt it.
`201` for a new send, `200` for a replay of an `Idempotency-Key`.
